About.title: We bring the splash — you make the memories
About.intro: Big Wave Slides turns ordinary days into water-park adventures — family-owned, fully insured, and obsessed with safe, spotless fun, delivered nationwide.
About.storyP1: What started with a single backyard slide and a big dream is now the region's most-trusted water slide company — serving families, schools, churches, hotels, and entire cities.
About.storyP2: We sell, rent, and install premium slides, and we sweat every detail so your event is effortless. Delivery, setup, safety checks, and pickup — all handled by our team.
About.missionText: To make world-class water fun safe, simple, and accessible for every celebration.
About.value1Desc: Every unit is inspected, cleaned, and fully insured before it arrives.
About.value2Desc: We deliver and set up on schedule so your day runs smoothly.
About.value3Desc: Commercial-grade slides built to thrill and built to last.
About.value4Desc: Friendly, reliable service from your first call to final pickup.
About.teamDesc: The friendly faces who make every splash happen.
About.areaDesc: We deliver across the metro area and beyond. Not sure if we reach you? Just ask.
About.whatRentDesc: Commercial-grade water slides, bounce houses, and combos from $199/day — delivered, professionally set up and anchored, sanitized before every event, fully insured, and picked up when the fun is done. You bring the guests; we handle everything else.
About.whatBuyDesc: The same heavy-duty, commercial-grade inflatables we trust in our own fleet, available to buy with nationwide delivery — perfect for venues, event pros, and anyone starting a rental business of their own.
About.how1Desc: Pick your slide, date, and city and tell us about your event. Your personalized quote arrives instantly by email with a secure link to review it online — free, no obligation.
About.how2Desc: Accept your quote in one tap and your official invoice is issued instantly. Reserve with a 50% deposit or pay in full — using secure payment details issued individually for your order.
About.how3Desc: Our crew delivers, sets up, anchors, and safety-checks your slide before the party starts — then comes back to take it all down.
About.whereText: Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, and delivering coast to coast — backyards, parks, schools, churches, and community events in all 50 states. Wherever the party is, we bring the wave.

Contract.title: Rental Agreement
Contract.paymentNote: No payment is taken online. Big Wave Slides will email an invoice with payment details to confirm this booking.
Contract.term1: The renter agrees to provide a safe, level setup area with access to power within 50 ft and to keep the equipment clear of hazards.
Contract.term2: Adult supervision is required at all times during use. The renter enforces the capacity, age, and safety guidelines provided by Big Wave Slides.
Contract.term3: Equipment must not be moved after setup. The renter is liable for damage beyond normal wear, loss, or theft while in their care.
Contract.term4: A refundable security deposit may be required and is returned after inspection. Cleaning or repair costs may be deducted.
Contract.term5: Bookings may be rescheduled for safety due to severe weather at the discretion of Big Wave Slides. Cancellation terms are confirmed in your invoice.
Contract.term6: This agreement is request-based: dates are tentatively held and only confirmed once Big Wave Slides accepts the booking and payment is arranged.
Contract.signedNote: This electronic signature is legally binding and recorded with a timestamp and IP address.
Contract.voidNote: This contract has been voided. Please contact us for a new agreement.
Contract.signIntro: By signing, you confirm you’ve read and accept the terms above.
